minimap.title: DBM
minimap.description: Configure dungeon mechanics inside the shared overlay.
minimap.redirect: DBM settings moved to Overlay > DBM.
minimap.edit.title: DBM Layout Edit
minimap.edit.dragHint: Drag here to move the DBM panel
minimap.settings.display.title: Display Options
minimap.settings.display.description: Control the minimap information density during combat and reduce noise.
minimap.settings.autoHideInDailyScenes.d: Automatically hide the minimap overlay in daily scene blacklist entries and restore its previous visibility after leaving.
minimap.settings.hideNormalTeammates.lab: Only show self and teammates affected by mechanics
minimap.settings.hideNormalTeammates.des: When enabled, normal teammate points are hidden; teammates with mechanic colors or buffs are shown automatically.
minimap.settings.showBoss.label: Show Boss Position
minimap.settings.showBoss.description: Show the current dungeon boss position on the minimap when enabled. Off by default to reduce noise.
Flash and color your name in the mechanic calls panel when you are targeted.
minimap.settings.selfMechanicColor.label: Self Target Color
minimap.settings.selfMechanicColor.descr: Color used for your name when a DBM mechanic targets you.
minimap.settings.mapOrientation.label: Map Orientation
minimap.settings.mapOrientation.descript: Choose whether the DBM map keeps north fixed or rotates so your character faces up.
minimap.settings.mapRefreshRate.label: Map Refresh Rate
minimap.settings.mapRefreshRate.descript: How often the map redraws position updates. Lower values feel smoother but use more CPU.
minimap.settings.playerVisibility.title: Player Visibility
minimap.settings.playerVisibility.descri: Keep specific players visible on the DBM map even when normal teammates are hidden.
minimap.settings.alwaysShowPlayers.label: Always show players
minimap.settings.alwaysShowPlayers.descr: Shows every player the DBM map knows about. This overrides hiding normal teammates.
minimap.settings.playerWhitelist.title: Player Allowlist
minimap.settings.playerWhitelist.name: Name
minimap.settings.playerWhitelist.quickAd: No recent players available to add.
minimap.supported.title: Supported Scenes
minimap.supported.description: DBM callouts currently appear only in these scene families. Other scenes can show the panels in edit mode, but no mechanics are produced until support is added.
minimap.overlay.title: Panel Visibility
minimap.overlay.description: Control which independent panels are visible in the dungeon mechanics overlay.
minimap.overlay.help: Use the sidebar Toggle Overlay and Edit Overlay buttons to show or position these DBM panels.
minimap.settings.colors.title: Player Colors
minimap.settings.colors.description: Set self and teammate colors when no mechanic color override is active; mechanic callouts still use the high-contrast slot palette.
minimap.settings.localRing.title: Self Marker
minimap.settings.localRing.description: Draw an extra ring around your minimap dot so you can locate yourself even when mechanic colors override your marker.
minimap.settings.localRing.enabled.label: Show self ring
minimap.settings.localRing.enabled.descr: When enabled, an additional configurable outline is drawn around your own dot.
minimap.s3Raid.causalJump.label: Causal Jump Ricochet
minimap.s3Raid.killMark.label: Execution Sentence
minimap.settings.showMarkers.label: Show Markers
minimap.settings.showMarkers.description: Show party markers (1-6) on the minimap when enabled. Drawn as colored numbers on the map only. Off by default.
minimap.settings.localFacing.label: Show facing indicator
minimap.settings.localFacing.description: When enabled, a small arrow pointing in your current facing direction is drawn on your own marker.
